header.title: A Decade of Learning and Innovation.

body.1: — Arffornia is more than a Minecraft server.
body.2: It's a whole ecosystem combining a {Laravel} website with {MySQL}, an {Electron} game launcher, interconnected server instances with a Velocity proxy, and a scalable {Kubernetes} (k8s) infrastructure for high availability. Built on {Proxmox}-managed virtualization.
body.3: — This 10+ year project has been my playground for learning, innovation, and technical refinement.

blocks.kubernetes: I designed my infrastructure around Kubernetes for scalability and reliability, enabling seamless interconnection of independent modules.
blocks.electron: Cross-Platform Desktop Apps Framework, that I used to create my game launcher on: Windows, Mac and Linux.
blocks.laravel: Backend PHP framework, that I used to create my website and web API using MVC architectural pattern.
blocks.docker: I've extensively used Docker to create independent modules for my k8s.
blocks.github: Automated deployments and test pipelines were built using Github CI/CD, connected to my k8s using ArgoCD.
blocks.java: I develop Forge mods and Spigot/NMS plugins to directly integrate the environment into the game.
blocks.php: I used PHP extensively for the web API and the Laravel website.
blocks.mysql: I used MySQL to manage all my databases.
blocks.typescript: I extensively used TypeScript for developing the game launcher built on Electron.
blocks.proxmox: Manage all my VMs and interconnect them with several physical servers.
blocks.argocd: I built my K8s infra around an ArgoCD controller to achieve deeper integration with the CI/CD pipeline.
blocks.grafana: Have an overview of all my services and create new data by combining other statistics, so that I can anticipate and guide my next choices.

description.1: Arffornia is a Minecraft modded server where players can create technological, magical, and diverse cities, embark on adventures with friends, and share unforgettable moments with the community.
description.2: The 5th season, set to release in a few months, is currently in development and will feature major updates, including a new launcher, an improved website, and the introduction of a progression stage system across various mods.

description.1: The game launcher allows users with just two clicks to login (using Microsoft Account), download and install the game along with all its mods, configure settings, Java version and start playing all in a highly intuitive and user-friendly way on Windows, Mac and Linux.
description.2: Initially developed using JavaFX, I switched to Electron to speed up development and leverage enhanced front-end capabilities using Vue.js. This transition allowed me to create a more modern and visually appealing application, simplifying tasks that would have been complex and time-consuming to achieve with JavaFX.

blocks.java: I develop the previous game launcher with Java & JavaFX.

description.1: To ensure direct visibility on the internet and to centralize my services—such as Account Management, Downloads, API, and more—I developed a website using Laravel. In 2023, I migrated to Laravel to enhance security, expand functionality, and stay up to date with modern web technologies.

The high resource demands of multiple Minecraft server instances and additional services required a highly efficient and robust infrastructure to ensure smooth gameplay. The infrastructure is built around several interconnected physical machines, virtualized with Proxmox, and hosting a Kubernetes (k8s) cluster that runs and monitors all services.
description.2: Above that, I use a Pterodactyl service to manage all Minecraft server instances, with a Velocity Proxy interconnecting them. To enable communication across all services, the Laravel website, featuring a custom API connected to a MySQL database.

description.1: Arffornia ecosystem is built with a modular design, allowing new features and functionalities to be seamlessly integrated through a {philosophy}. To achieve this, I leverage ArgoCD and a GitHub CI/CD pipeline to fully automate deployments. All configurations are managed within a Git repository, ensuring that every change is tested in a dedicated staging environment before being deployed to production. The infrastructure is designed to scale effortlessly based on current server load, dynamically allocating resources during peak usage. In the event of an issue, such as a server instance crash, the corresponding Kubernetes pod automatically initiates a restart, and I am immediately notified to ensure swift resolution.

body.1: This school project served as an introduction to {nn} and {cv}. Over the course of 3 months, we worked in teams of 4 to build the project from scratch, without any libraries. A key aspect of the project was independently researching the new knowledge necessary to successfully implement concepts like {cnn} (Convolutional Neural Networks) and {cv}.

description.1: We have made a point of using highly efficient post-processing, both in terms of final rendering and processing speed. Whether the image is very blurry, with distorted perspectives or a crumpled newspaper page. That's not a problem!

The second major part of this project was to design a neural network from scratch, with no specific library and no prior knowledge. After a long phase of reflection, calculation and design. We arrived at a very interesting and robust result.

description.1: Upside Down immerses you in a state-of-the-art laboratory, testing the very first prototype of the “GraviSphere”. A new scientific breakthrough that lets you manipulate the surrounding gravity. You're in charge of testing its potential via various tests to certify the user's integrity.

maps.title: 15 Hours of Unforgettable Gameplay.
maps.description: Step into six unique test chambers designed to push the limits of your skills with the GraviSphere under real-world conditions. Each chamber is carefully crafted to challenge different aspects of gravity manipulation, from precision control to rapid reflexes. Stay alert — the test environments can be unforgiving, and mistakes can be costly.
